title: Timer
description: Lightweight but packed with features – this timer plugin for Spigot/Paper 1.21+ is perfect for speedruns, minigames, or server events. Enjoy a clean action bar display, full color support, and reliable persistent storage.
body:
# Timer

A powerful and lightweight timer plugin for Minecraft servers (Spigot / Paper 1.21+). Perfect for events, speedruns, or minigames – with action bar display, color support, and persistent saving.

# 🚀Features & Technical Highlights🚀
- Supports Spigot & Paper 1.21+
- Action bar updates for all online players simultaneously
- Clean architecture for easy extension

# ✨Timer Functionality✨
- Start, pause, and reset the timer
- automatically start/stop when joining/leaving the server

# 🎨 Color Support
- 16 different minecraft colors
- dynamic color changes while running
- colored numbers and time units

# 💾 Data Persistence
- automatic saving on critical events (e.g. server stop)
- robust error handling for file operations
- Graceful degradation - no data loss on crashes

# 🎮 User Experience
- full tab completion
- /timer help command with all parameters
- clear status information

# 🔒 Permissions

| Permission    | Description                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `timer.use`   | Access to basic commands          |
| `timer.admin` | Start, pause, and reset the timer |

# 📦 Installation
- download the timer.jar file
- place it into your server´s plugin folder
- restart the server
- done - enjoy your new timer!

# ✅ Why Timer?
- this plugin combines easy use with professional implementation
- No unnecessary ressource usage
- clean and modular code structure
- perfect for server owners who need a stable timer for events
